title: Jumbo Australian Rigatoni Pasta
description: A rich, tender Australian dish featuring jumbo rigatoni pasta, served with a hearty mother sauce base, and a side of steamed vegetables. This hangover-cure recipe is perfect for a comforting meal after a night out.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the beef stock, red wine, tomato paste, dried thyme, and dried rosemary to the saucepan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the jumbo rigatoni pasta to the saucepan and cook for an additional 8-10 minutes, or until the pasta is al dente.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the parmesan cheese until melted and well combined.
Season the pasta with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the jumbo rigatoni pasta hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
